versions.name: Golden Hit
versions.text: Spend all your {{GOLD}} and deal {{DMG}} to an enemy monster equals to the amount spent. Convert extra {{DMG}} into {{GOLD}}.
versions.note: Effect change described as: "Same, but now checks for DMG reduction when calculating excess DMG." Not listed in Version History for this card; assumed Beta 43.0 (the earliest it could be - seen by 2020-01-31).
